title: Array Gate

story.briefing: The gate out of the district only opens for a rising signal. It wants the length of the longest uninterrupted climb anywhere in the stream.
story.success: Longest climb accepted. The gate grinds open onto the forest beyond.

description: Given an array of readings, return the length of the longest run of consecutive readings that is strictly increasing. A single reading counts as a run of length 1. An empty array returns 0.
hints: This is the same shape as finding the longest run of a repeated character — only the test for "does this element continue the run" has changed.
A run of length 1 is always available, so the answer for a non-empty array is never 0. Decide what your best-so-far starts at.
Track the current run length and the best seen. When readings[i] is strictly greater than readings[i - 1], extend the current run; otherwise reset it to 1. Update the best each step.
